scope: Economics only; whole20 DE/EN +P20/40 actual cases +whole40 existing AM +7 actual physical cards +20 individual AB proposals +three original BY programs

findings.actualIssue: The actual WZ08-G source counts wholesale and retail trade plus repair of motor vehicles; two EN fields incorrectly label it retail only. DE Handel is a permissible abbreviation when paired with the provided original table/footnotes.
findings.minimalProposal: Replace retail in both fields with wholesale and retail trade; repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles. Retain every number, date, remaining case and DE field.

findings.actualIssue: A literal filter mandate contradicts treating an alternative process as a substitute without an exemption/equivalence premise.
findings.minimalProposal: In both languages make the explicitly fictional rule an emission minimum, explicitly met by both filter and process-change variants. Keep all four cost figures, uncertainty/horizon conditions and the other case unchanged.

findings.reason: Recommend AB2 rather than author AB3: whole goal and both briefs demand bounded effect analysis and a conditional subject judgement, without independent complex normative criteria or problem construction. This is an own classification, not an official per-goal curriculum AB.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Specialisation, cooperation and coordination form one assessable relationship: both the fruit-stall bottleneck and shared-flat transport require connecting distinct roles and scarce coordination capacity. Neither more helpers nor labels alone guarantee improvement.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: Apply the three principles to a bounded familiar situation; AB2 is justified by transfer beyond naming.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: The furniture order change and small repair firm distinguish business functions from people, rooms and hierarchy. Shared staff can perform several functions; both cases require relations between procurement, production, sales and administration.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: Represent and connect given functions in cases; AB2 does not require constructing a complete organisation.

goalReviews.titleDe: Kern- und Unterstützungsprozesse in Unternehmen analysieren
goalReviews.substantiveReason: Bakery maintenance/payroll enable core value creation; IT is core for a software provider but support for a restaurant. Classification follows the actual business model rather than a fixed list of departments.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: Analyse model-dependent core/support roles; AB2. The existing processes card is a short definition anchor, not sufficient evidence of case analysis.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Custom furniture/workshop and variant beverage flow-line cases separately cover workflow, division of labour, production type/procedure and IT. Digital approval/master-data control does not remove a physical finishing bottleneck or automatically correct wrong labels.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: One linked process analysis containing these aspects remains atomic; AB2 for bounded unfamiliar cases.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Apprentice-oriented jargon-heavy slides and buyer reliability claims require audience, purpose and inspectable criteria; missing dates/denominators limit a chart. Better design alone does not establish recruitment or sales effects.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: Criteria-led analysis of supplied presentations is AB2; no independent presentation production is added.

goalReviews.titleDe: Bedeutung des Marketings für Unternehmen einschätzen
goalReviews.substantiveReason: Bottle availability/unclear cleaning are concrete purchase barriers. Snack contributions are (3−1.50)×100=150 before and (2−1.50)×200−80=20 after, excluding other fixed costs. Turnover or unit sales is not profit or proof of advertising causality.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: Recommend AB2 rather than author AB3: whole goal and both briefs demand bounded effect analysis and a conditional subject judgement, without independent complex normative criteria or problem construction. This is an own classification, not an official per-goal curriculum AB.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Bicycle parts/repair/discount/instructions and meal-box household quantities/distribution/video cases require linking objectives, design and effects across mix areas; a measure can overlap areas and conflict with its target segment.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: Analyse given measures and mechanisms: AB2. Do not duplicate the separate mix recall card for every application goal.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: School pen refills and a supplied older-audience repair-kit profile require a coherent feasible four-area concept under budget/access constraints. The second case describes that specific supplied audience, not all older people.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB3 is supported by constructing and justifying an open coherent concept from competing constraints; the four-area card remains only a recall scaffold.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Workshop assets6000+2000+1000=9000, equity9000−4000=5000; service assets3000+1500+500=5000, equity5000−(1000+2000)=2000. Receivables and equity are not cash.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 for applying the supplied classification/balance relation. Two existing cards distinguish structure and equation without certifying balance-sheet mastery.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Cash machine purchase2000 is an asset swap; new loan2000 expands the balance sheet. Repayment500 contracts both sides; supplier debt300 refinanced to loan300 swaps liabilities. Principal movement is not interest or an immediate expense.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 for transaction-to-balance application and identifying the double-entry principle; the narrow debit/credit card is useful but does not assess posting proficiency.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Service150 on invoice minus rent80 yields period profit/equity+70; collection of an old receivable100 is not new revenue. Equipment purchase1000 and principal repayment100 are not immediate expense; depreciation200 and interest20 yield −220. Closing via profit/loss then equity is correctly simplified.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2: explain transaction effects and distinguish equity subaccounts/period result from cash movement; no dedicated duplicate memory card is needed.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Cafe revenue8000 and expenses3000+2500+1000+500=7000 yield1000 profit despite1000 unpaid revenue/noncash depreciation. Repair revenue4500 minus1800+2200+800+100=4900 yields400 loss; old500 collection is excluded from new income.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 for bounded period allocation/calculation. The existing GuV card is necessary for the income/expense/period anchor, not proof of calculation or cash-flow judgement.

goalReviews.titleDe: Bilanz und GuV mit Kennzahlen analysieren
goalReviews.substantiveReason: Service equity40/assets100=40%, profit20/average equity40=50%, profit20/sales200=10%; producer180/600=30%,30/180≈16.67%,30/300=10%. Retail100/400=25%,20/100=20%,20/1000=2%; specialist service50/100=50%,20/50=40%,20/200=10%. Explicit matching average/closing equity avoids an unstated denominator; equal profit or margin does not rank different industries universally.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 for calculating/interpreting provided ratios with sector limits. Supplied formulas and existing prerequisite anchors suffice; do not add an entire investment/financing recall pack.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: A real spreadsheet task must preserve units and source linkage: changing the third profit7→14 must change the chart. Financing assets200 divided into60 equity/140 debt gives30%/70%;80/120 gives40%/60%. Assets are the total, not a third composition slice; neither chart proves liquidity or automatic profitability.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 for actually constructing/checking linked charts for an audience. The profile is an expected performance contract, not evidence that a spreadsheet was already created.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Repair-day limited tools/budget and event-kit storage/returns require one connected model: value, customers, resources, process, revenues/costs and chosen basic decisions. Asking how capacity responds to duplicate demand/late return tests the model rather than an idea list or complete start-up certification.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB3 is coherent for open construction and revision of a basic project business model. The six-component card is a narrow scaffold; no project success or all prerequisite mastery follows from recall.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: The two repair/design role comparisons allow learner-chosen nonprivate interests and strengths, preserve overlaps between self-employment/employment, and ask exploration needs. No psychometric diagnosis, stereotype about quiet people or final career allocation is justified.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 is appropriate for case comparison and an own bounded exploratory reflection. This ordinary assessable goal is distinct from motivation-only semantic orientation.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Destatis2023 manufacturing7601361/201453≈37.73 and full WZ08-G5489308/543301≈10.10 employees per company are correct. The EN retail-only label incorrectly narrows that actual source section. Craft2024 rounded86/210≈40.95% and253/388≈65.21% support about41%/65.2%, with published40.9% from unrounded values. Statistical company/legal-unit definitions and dates differ; averages are not typical establishments or personal job/start-up chances.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB2 for dated data analysis, real spreadsheet charts and bounded implications with information gaps; no official per-goal demand-level claim.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Dated provided BAuA material distinguishes AI-related autonomy/relief from work intensity and checking needs; mobile-reachability material distinguishes flexibility from boundaries, coordination and unequal on-site options. Both cases demand a learner-chosen bounded career question, not a claim of universal job effects or causality from a cross-sectional study.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB3 is supported by reasoned opportunity/risk trade-offs and personally selected conditional consequences. Actual dated source material must be provided at task use; this profile is not proof of full PDF delivery or learner performance.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: The fictional filter case contains a concrete premise gap: a rule that literally requires a filter does not establish permission for the process-change substitute. Amend it to an emission minimum that both variants satisfy. On that explicitly shared basis, initial extra2000 and annual savings relative to filter500+300=800 suggest an undiscounted2.5-year crossover, subject to financing/horizon/capacity; no current German legal rule is claimed. Grant4000 of training6000 means own2000 plus time/opportunity costs, not guaranteed profit or coercion.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB3 is coherent once legal/model feasibility is explicit: compare public aims, private conditions, alternatives and conditional decisions. Only the first case needs bounded correction.

goalReviews.substantiveReason: Automation can lower costs while replacing some tasks and adding maintenance/training needs; packaging purchase−10% does not settle recyclability, consumer prices or whole costs. Several stakeholders and economic/social/ecological criteria support a conditional business-significance judgement without equating every cheap measure with welfare or CSR.
goalReviews.independentDemandLevelReason: AB3 is justified by weighing conflicting perspectives/criteria. One stakeholder evaluation stays atomic, with no extra recall card or individual stakeholder atom needed.
